purpose: R9: quantify whether the O(N) forward-complexity advantage is observable, or whether fixed overhead dominates the tested range.

analysis.verdict: Forward wall time is OVERHEAD-DOMINATED across N=50..1600: a 32x mesh increase raises warm Newton time only ~2.1x (fitted exponent 0.16 full range, 0.44 for N>=400), versus the O(N) prediction of 32x. The host-callback round trip plus Python/reshape dispatch, not the O(N*kl*ku) banded flop count, sets the cost. The O(N) claim is therefore ASYMPTOTIC ONLY on this hardware; no crossover into the linear regime is observed within N<=1600.

recommendation: Either extend the study to N where the banded flop count dominates (estimated N>>1600 at this overhead), or complete the FFI LAPACK kernel to remove the host callback, before quoting the O(N) advantage as measured.
